Transition, tapered, taper-flat, single-tapered, extended corner (straight- and curved-front), jetty, bubble jetty and visitor worksurfaces are handed: left-hand units shown in drawings, right-hand units available.

Corner straight-front and curved-front worksurfaces with unequal leg depths (18 3/8" x 23 1/2" / 23 1/2" x 18 3/8", e.g. UC124242 vs UC214242, UCC124242 vs UCC214242) are marked 'Handed' on the Statement of Line; choose the style whose A/B depth order matches the adjoining worksurfaces.

Spanner worksurfaces: 47"W x 29 1/2" and 59"W x 35 1/2" for freestanding applications with 1/2" cord drop worksurfaces; 48"W x 24" and 60"W x 30" for full-depth worksurfaces; 51"W x 31 1/2" and 63"W x 37 1/2" for panel-supported applications with 1/2" cord drop worksurfaces; 51"W x 25 1/2" and 63"W x 31 1/2" for use with 3" panels with full-depth worksurfaces (notched spanners have a 3" notch for Answer panels).
The same bullet peninsula worksurfaces can be used with either worksurfaces with 1/2" cord drop or with full-depth worksurfaces.
Linking peninsula 27" dimension includes notch width.
Size of linking peninsula worksurface to be used is determined by the panel system it will be used with (UPAC2748 has a 3" notch for use with Answer panels).
24"W and 30"W visitor worksurfaces are not available with cable scallops (visitor worksurfaces are specified on page 536, outside this section).
Universal Systems Worksurfaces are the main worksurface solution for Answer, Montage, and Kick panels; they can be panel-mounted or freestanding.
With 1/2" cord drop: a 1/2" gap at the back of the worksurface provides routing of cords (U-prefixed styles use 18 3/8", 23 1/2", 29 1/2", 35 1/2" depths).

Full-depth worksurfaces (W-prefixed styles, 18 7/8", 24", 30" depths) provide an uninterrupted working surface that fits flush to the panel and allows L-configuration planning (L-configurations without uneven gaps, p203).
Systems worksurfaces with 1/2" cord drop allow easy cord management with uniform gaps whenever corner worksurfaces are used.
Standard scallops allow large cord heads to pass below the desktop. Scallops can be eliminated for freestanding applications (Omit scallop option, no cost).
Universal Systems worksurfaces can be supported with cantilevers, center support panels, end panels, pedestals, legs, or desk supports; supports are always ordered separately.
Universal Systems worksurface user front edge available in 3 mm edge or ergonomic P-edge; full offering of Steelcase High-Pressure Laminates or veneers with specifiable 3 mm edge or P-edge colors.

Answer Freestanding Desks: built up from Universal components ordered separately and assembled onsite; non-handed desk components; full-height and half-height modesty panels available for desks and peninsulas.

Universal Tables: HPL tables available with 3 mm edge or P-edge; wood veneer tables with square (3 mm) edge; bases include T and X bases, post legs, C-leg, elliptical legs, adjustable-height legs, and cabby legs; can be tethered to Post and Beam.

Elective Elements worksurfaces (separate spec guide, not Universal): depths 24" or 30"; edges 3 mm plastic, wood edge profiles on laminate (square 5 mm, bullnose) or on wood (3 mm square, bullnose, waterfall, knife); scallops optional, round or square grommets available depending on shape (typically left, center, right locations); grommets must be used for worksurface cable/cord management to route cords below the desk top; scallops are for task light cord management only; Customiz stain or open line laminates available; supported with Elective Elements supports or Universal cantilevers and side support brackets.
Elective Elements height adjustability via height-adjustable storage and/or legs: maintenance adjustability range 29"H–32"H in 1/2" increments.

Panel-Mounted Worksurface Supports Integration Matrix: Universal Systems on-module supports, U style numbers (example UCANT, page 545) are the recommended solution for Answer panels and Kick panels, with both 1/2" cord drop and full-depth Universal Systems worksurfaces.

Universal Systems supports for Montage panels, Z style numbers (example ZUCANT; see Montage Solutions Specification Guide) are the recommended solution for Montage panels, with both 1/2" cord drop and full-depth Universal Systems worksurfaces. U-style supports are not marked for Montage; Z-style supports are not marked for Answer or Kick.
Alignment tabs will need to be knocked down when full-depth worksurfaces are used.
Corner 120° Systems Worksurfaces may not be panel-supported with Montage panels due to the unique design of the Montage 120° junction.

Systems Worksurfaces and Tables can be used together; Systems Worksurfaces can be used with Answer, Kick, and Montage frames, panel-supported or freestanding (on-module and off-module panel-supported, freestanding, tethered to Post and Beam).
26"H and 28 1/2"H legs may be installed 3", 6", or 9" from the edge of most Tables to accommodate nesting and slip-fit capability.
Freestanding tables with legs installed 6" or 9" from the edge allow the worksurface to slip-fit over the panel-mounted Systems Worksurface.
Adjustable-height legs are available on Systems Worksurfaces and Tables; legs adjust 25 1/2"H to 31 1/2"H in 3/4" increments.
Tether brackets are available to secure Tables to Post and Beam fence.

U-Configuration with Large Footprint: one 24"D x 72"W left-hand bubble jetty table BFJ2472LP; one 23 1/2"D x 60"W straight worksurface (P-edge) US2460P; one 23 1/2"D x 23 1/2"D x 41 1/2"W x 41 1/2"W corner, curved-front worksurface (P-edge) UCC224242P; one 23 1/2"D x 30"W visitor, curved-front worksurface (P-edge) UVC2430RP.

L-Configuration with Large Footprint (full depth): one 24"D x 24"D x 60"L angled peninsula worksurface WPA2460; one 24"D x 24"W straight worksurface WS2424; one 24"D x 96"W straight worksurface WS2496. All worksurfaces symmetrical, easy to plan mirror image applications.

U-Configuration with Medium Footprint (6x7 footprint, 18 3/8"D): two 18 3/8"D x 30"W straight worksurfaces US1830; two 18 3/8"D x 18 3/8"D x 41 1/2"W x 41 1/2"W corner, curved-front worksurfaces UCC114242.
L-Configuration with Small Footprint A (6x6 footprint): one 30"D x 24"D x 72"W taper-flat worksurface WTTF3272; one 18 7/8"D x 48"W straight worksurface WS1848.

L-Configuration with Small Footprint B: one 24"D x 48"W capsule table (P-edge) BFK2448P with nesting-height legs nesting under panel-mounted Systems Worksurfaces; one 18 3/8"D x 60"W straight worksurface (P-edge) US1860P.

Penta Cube (Answer panels): six 24"D x 60"W x 60"W x 24"D corner, curved-front worksurfaces (3 mm edge) UCC226060; five linking peninsula worksurfaces (3 mm edge) UPAC2748; one straight worksurface (3 mm edge) US2460.
Supports for freestanding and panel-mounted applications must be specified separately (straight, soft-edge, transition, tapered, taper-flat, single-tapered, spanner, bullet/angled/linking peninsula).

Corner worksurfaces (flat-front, dual corner flat-front, straight-front, curved-front, extended corner straight/curved-front, 120°): supports must be specified separately, including side support brackets for rear corner support in panel-mounted applications.

Long worksurface spans may require additional support; reinforcing channels (page 546) allow for unsupported spans greater than 54". See page 208. (Tip appears on straight, soft-edge, transition, tapered, taper-flat, single-tapered, extended corner and bullet peninsula pages.)
Worksurfaces with personal caddy do not require an additional reinforcing channel but may require additional support for longer spans.

Personal caddy (page 542) is ordered separately to be used with the Cutout for Personal Caddy option (specify left-hand or right-hand cutout); available only on straight and straight soft-edge worksurfaces.

Personal caddy is available on worksurfaces with 3 mm, soft or wood square edges, 24"D or 30"D. Caddy is available on worksurfaces 54"W to 72"W (if only with caddy), 66"W and 72"W (if with tray and caddy), and 72"W (if with soft edge and caddy).
Worksurfaces with personal caddy have leg restrictions; see page 210 for connections.
48"W worksurface with soft edge used with FrameOne post leg has some limitations; see page 211 for connections.

Power and data access door and tray (page 540) is ordered separately to be used with the no-cost cutout option. Cutout offered on straight, straight soft-edge, tapered and tapered soft-edge worksurfaces. See page 210 for worksurface size availability matrix.
Power and data access door and tray only fits on tapered worksurfaces that are 24" to 30" and 30" to 24" deep.
Dual corner, flat-front worksurfaces must be panel hung.
23 1/2"D dual corner, flat-front worksurfaces must be supported with a center support on each side; 29 1/2"D dual corner, flat-front worksurfaces can be supported with a cantilever or center support.
Dual corner keyboard surface adjusts 6" higher or 5" lower than worksurface height.
Bullet peninsula and linking peninsula worksurfaces are recommended for use with other curved-front shapes such as corner, curved-front worksurfaces (page 521).

To specify 3 mm edge profile, no suffix is required. For all other edge profiles add a suffix: P = laminate with plastic P-edge, SW = wood with square edge, K = laminate with knife edge; for soft-edge straight worksurfaces WS = wood with square edge (US2448S -> US2448SWS). A suffix is valid only where the table prints a price for that edge column (N.A. = not available).

Laminate-only families (no wood): tapered, tapered soft edge, taper-flat, single-tapered, corner flat-front, dual corner flat-front, corner straight-front, extended corner straight-front, angled peninsula. Wood veneer (SW/WS) also offered on: straight (cord drop), straight soft edge (cord drop), transition (cord drop), corner curved-front (cord drop), extended corner curved-front (cord drop), corner 120°, spanner (USPC), bullet peninsula (30" x 59 1/2"+), linking peninsula.
Full-depth (W-prefixed) styles are laminate only; no wood or P-edge. Plastic knife edge (K) is priced only for full-depth straight (WS) and full-depth tapered (WTT) styles.

Open Line laminate on High-Pressure Laminate worksurfaces: +$65 plus cost of laminate. Wood options: Premium wood 2 / Premium wood 3 (price from electronic catalog or SmartTools), Customiz stain (no cost), full-fill finish (per-style add shown in table). Wire manager for wood veneer worksurfaces, if selected: black.
Soft edge worksurfaces: specify with or without antimicrobial soft edge (no cost). Soft edge profile centered on worksurface with 3 mm edge on balance of front edge.

Omit scallop(s) available at no cost on families with cable scallops (straight, soft-edge, transition, tapered, taper-flat, single-tapered, all corner types, bullet peninsula). Spanner, angled peninsula and linking peninsula list no scallop.

No grommet options are offered on Universal Systems worksurfaces in pages 505-531; cable scallops on back edges are standard. Grommets are described only for Elective Elements worksurfaces (page 200).
For Canadian pricing multiply U.S. price by the Canadian price factor (see page 1).
